title: Undeclared almond recall for Valley Harvest spinach
content: Valley Harvest is recalling selected 10-ounce bags of Garden Fresh Spinach because the packages may contain undeclared almonds. The affected bags have lot code VH0826 and a best-by date of September 2, 2026. Customers with almond allergies should not eat the product and may return it to the store for a refund.
